Financial Analyst, FP&A
Boston, MA

About the role
You will support monthly close, budgeting and forecasting for a 600-person manufacturing company, and build the models our leadership team uses to plan.

Key responsibilities
- Build and maintain financial models for the annual budget and quarterly forecasts
- Prepare variance analysis and management reporting each month
- Partner with department heads on budgeting
- Improve reporting in NetSuite and Excel

Qualifications
- 3+ years in FP&A, corporate finance or public accounting
- Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modeling
- Experience with NetSuite or a similar ERP
- Working knowledge of SQL
- Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting required
- CPA or CFA is a plus
